summary:
The feature is implemented but unverified: I could not run tests or flake8, per the instructions. Nothing was committed.

Changes:
- New monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver: save, save_batch, finalize; insertion-ordered cache, overwrite-false merge in place with file-only keys appended).
- New monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver: save, save_batch, private static _create_file_basename; resolves dtype to the data's own dtype when None).
- monai/data/nifti_writer.py: default dtype is np.float32 (same value as before).
- monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py: adds plot_2d_or_3d_image; existing GIF helpers unchanged.
- monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py: output_dir, dtype default None, delegates to NiftiSaver.save_batch, then logs the info message.
- monai/handlers/classification_saver.py: filename before overwrite; completion hook is bound method _finalize_on_completed(self, _engine) calling finalize().
- monai/handlers/tensorboard_handlers.py: index before max_channels; batch transform called once; delegates to the plot function; original ValueError wording kept.
- Renamed callers: examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py, unet_evaluation_dict.py, tests/integration_sliding_window.py. tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py passes filename.
- New tests: tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py.

Choices: CSV saver no longer logs (spec says savers do not log); the plot function's 3D branch now writes only channel 0 (the old code returned after the first channel anyway).

Checks done by reading and grep only: no lines over 120 characters, no trailing whitespace, single newline at end of each changed file, no remaining output_path references in monai, examples, or tests. Not verified: test results, flake8, ignite 0.3.0 attach behavior.
